Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Let's say I have a Samedi with Masochism on it. I play regenerative blood
on the same samedi.

I'm in combat with a minion who inflicts two damage to me, which I pay only
one blood to heal. I still put 2 counters on the Masochism, correct? I
*did* take two damage.

Similarly, if I do one damage to the opposing minion in said combat and they
have potence, they can still disarm me, correct?

Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
> I'm in combat with a minion who inflicts two damage to me, which I pay only
> one blood to heal. I still put 2 counters on the Masochism, correct? I
> *did* take two damage.

Correct.

> Similarly, if I do one damage to the opposing minion in said combat and they
> have potence, they can still disarm me, correct?

Yep. Effects like Disarm don't care about how much blood you spent
healing it - it was still the amount of damage they dealt.

Fanboy
